title: Add Request ID & Structured Logging Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware that generates a unique request ID for every incoming request and logs structured request/response data (method, path, status, duration). This improves traceability, debugging, and integrates with existing logging without adding dependencies.
testCases: Verify that each request receives a unique `X-Request-Id` header and that the ID is attached to the request object
Confirm that the logger outputs a JSON line containing request ID, method, path, status code, and response time
Ensure that the middleware does not interfere with existing routes, static file serving, or error handling
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains green, and manual verification shows a unique X-Request-Id header and correctly formatted log line for each request. No performance regression (>5% latency increase) is observed.
reason: Production services need reliable request tracing for debugging and monitoring. Adding built‑in request IDs and structured logs eliminates the need for third‑party solutions, aligns with the framework's zero‑dependency goal, and provides immediate operational value.
